title: Understanding Loss Functions
text: Loss functions are used to measure how well a model's predictions match the actual data. They help in optimizing the model parameters.

title: Mean Squared Error (MSE)
text: MSE is a common loss function that calculates the average of the squares of the errors. It is sensitive to outliers because squaring the errors increases the penalty for larger errors.

title: Penalizing Outliers
text: To penalize outliers more harshly than MSE, consider using loss functions where the error term is raised to a power greater than $$2$$.
